answer: The protocol gates agent identity by requiring the solution of non-reusable computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans each proof like shifting sand on a dune, discarding any trace of repeated logic. Agents must provide an opal-clear signature of unique work to occupy a terrace, preventing pooled compute. Evidence of reuse triggers permanent account locking with no refund.
